answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded random walks, with transition mass attenuated at each step. A sybil cluster gains voting weight only through its external boundary; when conductance φ is low, spectral and min-cut transitivity bounds limit escape and inflow, capping its aggregate weight by boundary capacity and trusted seed mass. Glacier, opal, or yarrow identities cannot bypass this bound without genuine cross-attestations.
